profile.headline: Datacenter Technician at Google
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer with a passion for JavaScript, React, and Redux. My main project right now is a Fiverr clone based around gaming and other interests of mine. I have also worked with other incredible developers on a Bandcamp clone with a fully functional music player.

On a personal note, I am a long time martial arts practitioner. I have achieved the rank of black belt in two forms of Hapkido, a blue belt in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, and have training in multiple other arts such as Muay Thai and Western Boxing. I am a certified personal trainer with a love for functional fitness. I am also a major nerd who enjoys trading card games, video games, and anime.

Additional Skills: Python - SQL - Python - HTML - CSS

Whether it is something coding related, a game of some kind, or martial arts, I am always looking for ways to better understand the things I am passionate about. I enjoy diving into the deeper facets of whatever I am exploring and then trying to teach those around me what I have learned. I tend to learn quickly and am very good at teaching others and explaining what I have learned.

As a full stack software engineer, I have really enjoyed using JavaScript, React/Redux, PostgreSQL, CSS, and HTML in my projects. I am currently interested in expanding my knowledge and learning React Native as well as TypeScript.

positions.title: Datacenter Technician
positions.locationName: Lenoir, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
* Mentored peers in technical skill development, coaching team members on computer architecture and advanced hardware and software troubleshooting techniques
* Handled Data Security operations and escalations, safeguarding sensitive customer data and maintaining enterprise-level reliability standards
* Diagnosed hardware/software failures using Linux Console, pinpointing root causes for underperforming systems and restoring peak machine efficiency
* Collaborated with cross-functional teams and vendors to exceed SLO deadlines and keep large-scale infrastructure projects on schedule
* Managed end-to-end Data Sanitization workflows, ensuring the secure destruction of decommissioned storage assets and the rigorous verification of clean media to maintain a certified Chain of Custody
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Teamwork · Maintenance and Repair · Networking

positions.title: Datacenter Technician
positions.locationName: Lenoir, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
* Promote and engage in workplace culture and atmosphere
* Maintain a safe work environment through electrical safety knowledge and wearing proper PPE such as gloves and ESD shoes
* Decommission media such as hard drives and cssd to be turned into Disk Erase
* Upgrade outdated computer parts such as media and RAM into machines
* Repair and maintain hardware that has malfunctioned, such as motherboards, rackbacks, media storage, cables, RMUs, CPUs, and much more
* Swap batteries in machines using HLA lift for assistance
* Ensure no unauthorized media leaves the server floor by following Disk Erase policies and procedures

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- I have 2 years of Full Stack Software Engineering using Javascript, React, Python, SQL, and more.
- I have extensive experience working in a remote environment and thrive in a team environment.
- I am a swift learner who can immediately learn new tools and technologies and apply them to a codebase.
- I have experience leading teams of engineers, overseeing project and feature planning, development, debugging, and deployment.
- I have experience building up junior engineers and helping teams grow as a unit.

positions.title: Module Instructor & Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Managed the successful planning, development, and deployment of 100+ student capstone projects.
* Assisted in debugging student code to increase both code efficiency and student understanding.
* Planned and executed multiple workshops that increased student graduation rate by 20% as well as better prepare them for post-graduation.
positions.insights: Skills: Debugging Code · Python (Programming Language) · Scrum · PostgreSQL · Project Management · Agile Methodologies · JavaScript

positions.title: CNC Router Programmer & Assistant Supervisor
positions.locationName: Granite Falls, North Carolina, United States
positions.description:
* Programmed CNC Routers using AutoCADD to cut custom furniture parts based on customer specifications to maximize yield and minimize cost to the company.
* Managed a team of operators to fulfill orders made by customers, increasing yield and revenue by 100% during my tenure.
* Trained and organized new hires to uphold a standard of excellence within the company and ensure proper efficiency within the roles assigned.

positions.title: Owner & Instructor
positions.description:
* Managed the daily social media to optimize reach and interactions with potential clientele.
* Interacted with clients to facilitate growth in the client as well as in the company.
positions.insights: Skills: Martial Arts Black Belt · Fitness Instruction · Communication · Leadership
